# TTT — The Kaspa Super App (tttz.xyz)
> Compact map for AI agents / LLMs. Full detail: README.md

## What this is
TTT ("Tap To Tip") is a Kaspa (KAS) super app: 100+ live apps in one React SPA — non-custodial wallet, on-chain tipping + social feed, autonomous AI agents, x402 payments (AWA), covenant NFTs (KCC), a KAS⇄iKAS L2 bridge (Igra), analytics hubs (Slobz), and a P2P marketplace. Built on the Base44 BaaS.

## Stack
React 18 + Vite 6 + React Router 6 + Tailwind 3 + shadcn/ui (Radix) + Framer Motion + Recharts + Three.js + Leaflet + Remotion. Backend: Base44 SDK (auth, entities, Deno functions, integrations). Icons: lucide-react only.

## Critical conventions (do not break)
- `src/App.jsx` is the ONLY router. `src/pages.config.js` is a legacy loop covering OLD pages only — every NEW page needs an explicit `<Route>` in App.jsx. Never delete the loop.
- Never delete working pages or code. Prefer `find_replace`. Create new focused files over bloating existing ones.
- Imports use `@/` alias (→ src/). Never relative src/ paths.
- Styling: tokens in `src/index.css`, mapped in `tailwind.config.js`. Use token classes (`bg-primary`, `font-heading`), never hardcoded hex.
- Auth pages (Login/Register/ForgotPassword/ResetPassword) already exist in src/pages/ — never recreate. Gate authed pages with `ProtectedRoute`.
- Entities: `base44/entities/*.jsonc`, full JSON schema, no built-in fields (id, created_date, updated_date, created_by_id). RLS per operation.
- Backend functions: `base44/functions/<name>/entry.ts` (Deno). Use `createClientFromRequest(req)` for the SDK.

## Directory map
- `src/App.jsx` — router (source of truth for routes)
- `src/pages/` — one file per route (Home.jsx, AWA.jsx, Slobz.jsx, ...)
- `src/components/ui/` — shadcn primitives (one export per file)
- `src/components/<feature>/` — feature-scoped components
- `src/api/base44Client.js` — pre-initialized Base44 SDK
- `src/lib/` — AuthContext, utils, query-client, TitleManager
- `base44/entities/` — entity schemas (~120)
- `base44/functions/` — backend functions (Deno handlers, ~130)
- `base44/agents/` — in-app AI agent configs (.jsonc)
- `public/llms.txt` — this file
- `index.html` — SEO meta, OG tags, Agent Control Bridge (iframe postMessage API)

## Core pillars (routes)
- Wallet: /Terra /Wallet /WalletHub — non-custodial KAS, KRC-20
- Social+tipping: /Feed /Tip /SendTip /DAGFeed
- AI agents: /AgentZK /ZekuAI /AIAgentHub
- x402 payments: /AWA /AWASigner — HTTP-402 AI services paid in KAS
- Covenant NFTs: /KCC /KCCNft — L1-enforced
- Covenant deployer: /SuperZK (admin) — zktimelock/zkescrow/zkvault
- L2 bridge: /IgraHorizon /IgraAgent /DEX — KAS⇄iKAS
- Analytics: /Slobz /SlobzTxTracker /SlobzSiteTracker
- P2P market: /SlobzMarket /SlobzGigs — covenant escrow gigs

## Key entities
TrackedWebsite, SlobzEscrowGig, AWAInvoice, IgraAgentWallet, IgraBridgeSwap, AdventSponsorTask, SlobProfile, SlobMicroTask, SlobzWaitlist, ChestWallet, KlipzJob, TreeCampaign, User (built-in). ~120 total in base44/entities/.

## Key backend functions
slobzEscrow (covenant escrow lifecycle), scrapeWebsiteStats (website crawl + Lighthouse + AI SEO), awaX402 (x402 verify+fulfill), kccNft/kccNftMintPayment (covenant NFT), igraBridge/igraAgent (L2 bridge + signing), sendKaspaTransaction/slobzTestnetSend (on-chain sends), createKaspaWallet/deriveKaspaAddress, getKaspaBalance/getKaspaTransactionDetails/getKaspaUTXOs (RPC reads), verifyKaspaSelfTransaction/verifyKaspaSignature (proof verification), superzkDeployJob (covenant deploy), agentZKKaspaNode/zkEndpointExecutor. ~130 total in base44/functions/.

## Escrow direction (important)
`slobzEscrow` currently holds per-gig mnemonics server-side (custodial covenant, admin-only). Direction of travel: move to non-custodial (multisig / HTLC) so platform never touches private keys or seeds. Do not remove working escrow without a replacement.

## For LLMs editing this repo
- New page → new file in src/pages/ + explicit <Route> in App.jsx + import at top.
- New entity → base44/entities/Name.jsonc (full schema).
- New function → base44/functions/name/entry.ts, then test_backend_function.
- Use lucide-react icons only (must exist). Each shadcn file exports only its own primitives.
- Hooks at top level only. No require()/module.exports (ESM Vite). cn from @/lib/utils.
